layout_model.summary: Execution Quality declares 18 headers but renders 19 cells per row. Cells 0-3 sit under their declared headers. One UNDECLARED cell at index 4 carries truth_state. Every declared header from Status (header index 4) onward is therefore rendered ONE CELL TO THE RIGHT: declared header h is drawn at cell h+1 for h>=4. The declared columns are displaced RIGHT by one, never left. limit_px is rendered in no cell although it is non-null on 300/300 payload rows. The payload is complete; the render is displaced.
layout_model.rule: rendered_cell_index = declared_header_index for header_index<=3; rendered_cell_index = declared_header_index+1 for header_index>=4
layout_model.cell18_note: the 19th cell exists because of the undeclared chip, not because of an extra trailing column

time_elision_disclosure.note: The Time cell is ELIDED: every one of the 300 rows renders a 22-character cell made of a 21-character prefix of the ISO timestamp plus U+2026. Exact string equality with the payload timestamp is therefore 0/300. Agreement is measured on that 21-character prefix: 300/300 against the same row and 0/300 at the +37 mutation control. The prefix ALONE is not unique: 253/300 rows have a prefix that matches exactly one payload timestamp while 47 rows fall into groups of 2-4 events sharing the same 100 ms window (all 300 payload timestamps are distinct, and a 24-character prefix would be unique on 300/300). Combining the Time prefix with the elided Wallet head...tail raises uniqueness to 290/300, and Wallet alone already agrees 300/300 with only 64/300 at the +37 control, so row binding does not depend on Time prefix uniqueness. This is recorded as measured; the task-card wording "unique on 300/300 rows" is not supported by the committed payload.
